claim: negative weekend returns significantly predict Monday equity declines, while positive returns have no effect
quote: negative weekend returns significantly predict Monday equity declines, while positive returns have no effect
limitations: Abstract only (publisher page returned 403); no Sharpe, trading rule, cost or entry time given; the return window definition (Friday close vs Saturday 00:00, Sunday close) and whether the Monday return is close-to-close, gap or open-to-close are not stated in the abstract.
independent_replication: No independent replication found; the paper is a single-team Finance Research Letters study.
impact_on_spec: Founding claim of the direction: an asymmetric weekend-crypto to Monday-equity transmission, stronger after May 2022. This iteration tests whether any of it survives the frozen Monday-open fill rule.

claim: The overnight session operates from 8:00 PM ET Sunday to 4:00 AM ET Friday
quote: The overnight session operates from 8:00 PM ET Sunday to 4:00 AM ET Friday
limitations: Broker documentation of hours only; says nothing about overnight liquidity, spreads, or whether our SIP daily data has any Sunday-night price. Does not change the frozen close-signal to next-open contract.
independent_replication: Cross-checked by the Alpaca blog post announcing 24/5 trading (8:00 PM ET Sunday to 8:00 PM ET Friday).
impact_on_spec: Sets the execution question: Alpaca can trade US equities from Sunday 8:00 PM ET, so a Sunday-night fill exists at the broker, but it is a different fill rule from the frozen Monday-open one and is not tested here.

claim: leaving roughly 49 hours in which no US reference price exists at all
quote: leaving roughly 49 hours in which no US reference price exists at all
limitations: One quarter of data, thin weekend volume, wide spreads; a Yahoo-hosted syndicated piece, not peer reviewed; concerns tokenized single stocks, not index ETFs.
impact_on_spec: Warns that weekend prices already contain most of the Monday gap; supports the prior that any weekend-to-Monday transmission is realised in the Friday-close to Monday-open gap before a Monday-open fill.

claim: momentum strategies yield higher returns on weekends, with altcoins exhibiting a stronger differential than major coins
quote: momentum strategies yield higher returns on weekends, with altcoins exhibiting a stronger differential than major coins
limitations: Crypto-only, costs acknowledged but not quantified, Advances in Consumer Research (low tier venue), no equity leg.
impact_on_spec: Shows weekend crypto behaviour differs from weekday behaviour; relevant to whether W measured Friday 16:00 ET to Sunday 24:00 UTC is a distinct signal. Crypto-only: says nothing about equities.

claim: the Monday session already opens on Sunday at 17:00 exchange time
quote: the Monday session already opens on Sunday at 17:00 exchange time
limitations: Third-party clock site, not cmegroup.com (403 on scripted fetch); hours only, no evidence about how much crypto information futures absorb.
independent_replication: Consistent with the search-result summaries of CME Globex hours (Sunday 6:00 PM ET to Friday 5:00 PM ET).
impact_on_spec: ES futures reopen Sunday 17:00 CT (18:00 ET), so equity-index risk is priced before Monday 09:30 ET: the weekend information is expected to be in the Monday opening print.
